lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest on the posterior flank and becomes increasingly narrow and compressed toward the anterior/neck region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth vertical line (counting from posterior to anterior) located in the lower ventral region of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated line segments on the anterior flank terminate mid-body before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 distinct white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, centered above the articulation of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest of elongated hair extending from the mid-back to the tail base; distinct white terminal tuft on the ventral side of the tail.
